doc: Settling a browser.web card with session writes, in the user's settle, a matrix grant of the session with the card's number, and the same question asked again is allowed with no second card; the session hears the yes. A browser.private card for a LAN literal settled with session/cidr stores the target's /24 on its port in the grant-target wire form the web proxy reads. What makes it fail: a yes that writes no grant (a retry makes a new card), or a width stored in another shape.

sql: select title from card where id = $c1
rows: s1 wants to open web sites (first: example.com:443)

sql: select json_extract(e.data, '$.who.session'), json_extract(e.data, '$.what.matrix'), json_extract(e.data, '$.what.host') is null, json_extract(e.data, '$.expires') is null, json_extract(e.data, '$.card') = $c1, t.class from entity e join tx t on t.id = e.created_tx where e.kind = 'grant'
select count(*) from message where recipient = 'agent:s1' and text like 'your browser.web request (card $c1): allowed (session;%'
select count(*) from card where kind = 'matrix'
select json_extract(data, '$.what.target') from entity where kind = 'grant' and json_extract(data, '$.card') = $c2
